goal: Add a flywheel.loop_path_marker module that, given a unified-diff string, returns the set of watched loop-path signals it contains: a new Status/Outcome enum member or transition-rule entry, a new ADD COLUMN or table, a new Grader union variant, a new control-command verb, or a new store Protocol method.

references: Spec Behavior Specification -> Trigger Set table (signals 1-5, ranked by trust) is the authoritative detection spec; the watched files per signal are listed there.
src/flywheel/store_protocols.py -- Protocol classes (DomainEventStore, ControlCommandStore, etc.); signal 4's decidable core is a new `def` on one of these Protocols.
constraints: Pure string/diff analysis: the function takes the diff TEXT as input and returns the signals -- no git invocation, no file or JSON I/O in this module, so it is unit-testable in isolation.
Detect only added content (diff lines beginning with '+', excluding the '+++' file header); a watched symbol that merely appears in a context or removed line is not a hit.

Signal 4 must be scoped to its decidable core: a newly added `def` on a Protocol in store_protocols.py. Do NOT fire signal 4 on any-new-function-in-harness.py/orchestrator.py (spec line 80 -- that erodes the gate); the file-touch fallback is out of scope for this module.

Add tests/test_loop_path_marker.py with synthetic diffs covering each of the five signals plus the two FR-1 acceptance cases: a diff adding a Status enum member is marked; a diff that only renames a local variable in lifecycle.py is not.
Run mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every .py file you touch and fix all Pylance errors before reporting verify.
Commit the change with a Conventional Commits message (feat: ...) before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: Do not wire the marker into archive_completed_phases (archive-gate-loop-path owns that).
Do not compute the diff from git here (phase-base-diff owns diff acquisition).
edge_cases: A diff that adds then reverts the same column within one phase nets no new symbol -- operate on the cumulative diff text you are given; if the net added lines do not contain the symbol, do not fire.
A pure docstring/comment edit inside a watched file must not fire any symbol-level signal.
